name: Super Gun Golf
summary:
A new way to golf! The rules are simple; after you shoot, your shot will bounce around three times until it lands, and you take your next shot from there!

Features:
Up to four players
Private and public rooms
15 maps

2 modes:
Free For All - There are no turns, everyone races to the bullseye!
Turn-Based - Just like traditional golf, everyone takes turns and the fewest amount of shots to the bullseye wins!
